query:
SELECT c.id as card_id, c.name, ds.sourceUrl,
  ph.id as ph_id, ph.grade, CAST(ph.price AS DECIMAL) as price_hkd, ph.jpyPrice, DATE(ph.soldAt) as sold_date
FROM cards c
JOIN dataSources ds ON ds.cardId = c.id AND ds.source = 'snkrdunk'
JOIN priceHistory ph ON ph.cardId = c.id AND ph.source = 'snkrdunk'
WHERE c.name LIKE '%SM-P%076%'
  AND ph.grade IN ('PSA10', 'PSA 10')
ORDER BY ph.soldAt DESC
LIMIT 15;
